messages:
maria: opened PR to add a tiny troubleshooting note + SDK snippets for "detect-and-shorten" (context trims) — want node+py+cURL, a one-line decision note, and a reproducible smoke command that hits the trim-simulator.

sam: paste the node draft and i'll run it through snippet-lint. keep it <10 lines.

maria: node draft:
```javascript
// detect-and-shorten (minimal)
const r = await fetch(RW_URL, {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
if (r.status === 429) await retryHelper.backoff();
if (r.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim')) { payload.system = shrink(payload.system); await fetch(RW_URL, {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)}); }
```

kevin: i'll port to python requests + add a tiny pytest that mocks headers. question: do we want to surface the header name verbatim?

maria: say "inspect service metadata header (e.g., x-rw-context-trim)" and call out vendors may vary. don't hardcode as the only possible header.

olivia: editorial: add a one-liner decision: "When to use detect-and-shorten vs proactive trimming" and a 3-step checklist: Detect → Shorten → Retry → Fallback. also link to errref for 429/timeout semantics.

sam: CI will flag code-fence languages and trailing spaces — i'll catch those. also recommend using the SDK retry helper instead of a bespoke backoff snippet.

docs-bot: PR #1203 opened by maria — reviewers requested: @sam @kevin; labels: docs-snippet, needs-ci.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed for PR #1203: expected fenced lang "javascript" (found none); disallowed trailing spaces on lines 3-4. tests: snippet-lint-1 failing.

maria: fixing fences and whitespace now. adding curl smoke:```bash
# reproducible smoke against trim-sim
curl -i -X POST "$TRIM_SIM_URL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d @huge_prompt.json
# look for: x-rw-context-trim: true in response headers
```

kevin: once lint is green i'll submit a follow-up PR with pytest + fixture that returns headers={'x-rw-context-trim':'true'} so we have a runnable example in the docs-tests.

sam: run lint after your push and i'll do final approve. small nit: prefer calling the pattern "detect-and-shorten" consistently (hyphenated, lowercase).

liz: copyedit note: keep voice imperative in the checklist; add one-sentence "When not to use" (high-volume strict-latency use-cases => proactive upfront truncation).

maria: pushed fixes and updated heading to "detect-and-shorten: troubleshooting playbook". added links to errref (429/timeouts) and SDK retry docs. tagging @liz for final copyedit once CI is green.

ci-bot: snippet-lint passed for PR #1203 ✅.

docs-bot: PR #1203 updated — status: ready-for-review.

sam: quick pass looks fine, approving after liz read.

liz: final copyedit done; wording clean and examples reproduceable. LGTM. merge when you want.

maria: merging now, will follow up with kevin's pytest PR tomorrow. thanks team :rocket:
